facts.text: SatelliteTasking-v1 is registered to bsk_rl.gym:SatelliteTasking
SatelliteTasking is the single-satellite special case of GeneralSatelliteTasking and exposes the satellite's action space directly
SatelliteTasking exposes the satellite's observation space directly
SatelliteTasking refuses to be constructed with anything but exactly one satellite
The multi-satellite base composes a Tuple of the satellites' action spaces
The multi-satellite observation space composes the satellites' observation spaces and calls reset() when no simulator exists yet
A satellite subclass defines observation_spec and action_spec, which determine its observation and action spaces
The documented construction passes a configured satellite instance to gymnasium.make('SatelliteTasking-v1', ...)
With a discrete action spec the satellite's action space is Discrete(sum of each action's n_actions)
An integer action outside the discrete action space raises ValueError('Action index ... out of range')
Downlink is a DiscreteFSWAction
DiscreteFSWAction contributes one discrete action (n_actions=1)
Image is a DiscreteAction and Image(n_ahead_image) contributes n_ahead_image discrete actions
A list observation becomes Box(low=-1e16, high=1e16, shape=(len,)) and a scalar observation becomes a Box of shape (1,)
A Time observation returns the simulation time divided by its normalization, and the normalization is the time limit when norm is not set
The observation builder derives its space from the first observation it builds
reset stores self.seed, calls gymnasium's Env.reset(seed) and numpy.random.seed; a missing seed is time_ns() % 2**32
The reset options argument is unused
Each reset sets latest_step_duration to 0.0 s
reset returns the observation and the info mapping
A step applies a non-no-action action through Satellite.set_action and then runs the simulator
Satellite.set_action forwards the action to its action builder
Each step measures latest_step_duration as the change in simulator time
The step reward is the sum of the rewarder's reward_dict plus failure_penalty for each dead satellite
The episode terminates when a satellite is not alive or its rewarder terminates
The episode truncates when simulator time reaches time_limit or a rewarder truncates
The step returns observation, reward, terminated, truncated and info
info reports each satellite's requires_retasking and the last step duration as d_ts
SatelliteTasking flattens the satellite's info entries to the top level of the step info
A single-satellite step wraps the scalar action in a one-element list
close deletes the simulator when one exists
UniqueImageReward rewards each newly imaged target by its priority, once per target

determinism.notes: reset(seed) seeds the checked stand-in's random generator and the tasking rules are deterministic, so one implementation repeats a trajectory for the same seed and actions; upstream seeds numpy's global generator (src/bsk_rl/gym.py:346) while the fake uses Python's random.Random, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two implementations

gaps: the checked model is the package's analytic stand-in: it models the tasking state (action index, stored data and simulated time) directly and has no orbital, attitude, power, thermal, sensor or actuator dynamics, so its fidelity level is F0
the upstream environment propagates a Basilisk astrodynamics and FSW simulation; that engine is not imported by this package and was not run here

the fake's satellite is a test configuration (one Downlink and ten Image actions with a Time observation); every number in fake.py is test data, and the concrete action count belongs to that configuration, not to the upstream environment, whose action space is the configured satellite's
timestep_ms is 0 because an environment step is event-driven: upstream steps end at FSW events or at max_step_duration, while the fake advances a fixed number of simulated seconds per step
the fake uses Python's random.Random while upstream seeds numpy's global generator, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the two implementations
snapshot and restore are not offered: upstream exposes no get_state/set_state, so the bridge declares snapshot_restore false and replay is not available
the sim backend (gymnasium.make) needs installed bsk_rl and Basilisk and a configured satellite instance in env_kwargs; it was not run here

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
